description: FDA Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee voted AGAINST eteplirsen (Sarepta) for Duchenne muscular dystrophy -- 7-3 that the single historically-controlled study did not show it effective, and 7-6 against substantial evidence of dystrophin production likely to predict benefit.

source.id: NDA 206488 (eteplirsen); FDA PCNS Drugs Advisory Committee
source.verified: FDA advisory-committee calendar + Sarepta investor statement, verified 2026-09-13

knowable_time_source: adcom outcome public the same day (Sarepta issued a statement 2016-04-25). Verified 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: event_time == knowable_time (the vote and its disclosure coincide). An advisory-committee vote is a market-moving SIGNAL, not a final decision -- the FDA is not bound by it, and here it later granted accelerated approval (Sept 2016), another revision the dated-events store captures via a subsequent event.

outcome.note: Advisory-committee vote against; NOT the final FDA decision. Recorded as the adcom signal, not a claim about the stock reaction.

disclosure_timing_source: FDA advisory-committee vote concluded late in the 2016-04-25 public meeting; actionable the next session. (Adcom procedure -- all-day meeting ending late afternoon.)
